messages.author: 757f82d0e9848db8
messages.subject: Shiny-Server as service?
parts:
Hi All,

I'm running RHEL5, and am trying to launch some shiny apps. Just starting with a simple test app. Anyway, I know in shiny-server there's configuration to run as upstart for RHEL6 - unfortunately, I'm limited to RHEL5.

Is there some way I can configure shiny-server to run as a service, similar to httpd?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny-Server as service?
parts:
You might try this init.d script:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/blob/master/config/init.d/redhat/shiny-server

I think you would just put that in a file called /etc/init.d/shiny-server, then run (as root) "chkconfig shiny-server on".

It has NOT been tested by RStudio folks (hence it doesn't appear in our official docs) and I personally know almost nothing about init.d scripts, so proceed with caution!

messages.author: 757f82d0e9848db8
messages.subject: Re: Shiny-Server as service?
parts:
I've been using this init.d script for a week now, and it's working great! For a custom config file, I added this: 

args="/home/shiny/shiny-server.config"

under the lockfile variable. Then I changed the daemon line of the start function to:

 daemon $prog $args >> $logfile &

Works like a charm!
